page.overview:
What is Blood Templars?

The Blood Templars are a Loyalist Space Marine Chapter and a successor of the Blood Angels created during an unknown Founding.

The Blood Templars' Chapter colours are not listed in current Imperial records.

The Blood Templars' Chapter badge is not listed in current Imperial records.
